summary: WP-001 Template Method refactor is architecturally clean and correct. createPaginationNavContent() extracted as a protected hook in BaseGridRenderer with a sensible generic default. Bootstrap5Renderer correctly overrides with Bootstrap-specific markup. Bootstrap5Renderer::createPaginationRow() deleted — clean inheritance. Null-guard pattern for page-jump input placement is correct by design.

WP-002 self-healing write-back is correctly placed inside the stale-value detection branch, before the cache assignment, keeping cache and GridSettings consistent. The !empty($itemsPerPageOptions) guard correctly prevents spurious write-back for grids without IPP configured. ?? $fallback removal is justified; inline comment accurately captures the invariant.

WP-003 URL template setter/getter is clean. getItemsPerPageURLTemplate() fallback to computed template is correct. Security is sound: createItemsPerPageSelector() uses json_encode(..., JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR) to embed the URL template in inline JS — correctly prevents XSS from template injection. this.value values come exclusively from getItemsPerPageOptions() which enforces positive integers.

All acceptance criteria met. 127/127 tests pass; 0 PHPStan errors at level 6. New stale-persistence test correctly verifies the write-back side effect. All 6 IPP renderer tests now have realistic URL template setup and meaningful assertions.
